S.FORM: alang Hanbizan ga niya mki sku Nanto Keng atu Sin'iy go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 74 buwan, 245 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 64% kyan ku 158 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 36% kyan ku 87 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Bunun 64%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Hanbizan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Hanbizan hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Hanbizan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Hanbizan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Hanbizan hya' ga Kalibuan. tay mkyahu' na Hanbizan hya' ga Valana. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ ħanβizan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku nanto keŋ atu [s|ɕ]inʔij ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa βunun ** maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na ħanβizan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na ħanβizan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na ħanβizan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na ħanβizan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na ħanβizan ħjaʔ ɣa kaliβuan taj mkjaħuʔ na ħanβizan ħjaʔ ɣa *alana reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
